---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ofcskn
---

## Summary

A clear one-sentence description of the feature you are proposing.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the problem or limitation this feature addresses. Example: "As a user I can't delete my posts, which means..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the feature you would like to see, including how it should work from the user's perspective.

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative approaches? Why is your proposed solution better?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, links to similar implementations, or any other context.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have checked the [Roadmap](../../README.md#roadmap) and this feature is not already listed
- [ ] I have searched open issues and this has not already been requested
